Claim 281 (currently amended): A tool comprising: a first adhesive layer; a second adhesive layer; and a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and are aligned with each other; and an additional adhesive layer in registration with the medial section.  

Claim 291 (currently amended): The tool of claim 281 wherein the ring includes a central opening.  

Claim 287 (currently amended): The tool of claim 281 further comprising a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first adhesive layer and the perimeter of the second adhesive layer. 

Claim 288 (currently amended): The tool of claim 287 wherein the weld ring is continuous.
